# ISRO Launches GSLV-F18 Carrying NVS-03 Satellite as Attention Turns to Deployment

The Indian space agency, Isro, has launched its GSLV-F18 rocket in a high-profile mission that lifted off with the NVS-03 satellite aboard.

The primary objective of the flight is the delivery of the NVS-03 payload, which has been described as a powerful satellite. The launch vehicle, designated GSLV-F18, carried the spacecraft into flight during the newly initiated mission.

With the liftoff now completed, attention has immediately shifted to the deployment phase of the flight. Teams and observers are closely watching the mission to confirm whether the spacecraft successfully separates into its designated target area.

The event is currently being followed through live coverage, keeping the public and mission observers informed of the flight's ongoing progress in real time following the initial ascent.

Further details regarding the final status of the mission remain dependent on the upcoming deployment phase. Official confirmation of the outcome is awaited as tracking of the GSLV-F18 and the NVS-03 payload continues.
